name: Georama
summary:
Georama puts the whole planet under your floor, at real scale and in the right direction. Look down and you see
through the ground to the countries, coasts and city lights that really lie that way, curving away with the Earth.
Look straight down and you find the exact other side of the world: its coordinates, the 12,742 km straight through,
and the nearest big city.
Through the ground: the real-scale Earth below you, aligned to true north (point north once, or align to the Sun).
Rise from eye level to 10 km
